name: 1988 RH9
verdict_text: A faint spot in the right place, but not strong enough to be sure.

story.plain: Seen for only 11 nights in 1988, then lost. Nobody knows exactly where it is now. A faint spot in a 2025 SPHEREx photo lines up with one of its possible paths.

cloud.note: Sample: clones drawn from made-up uncertainties around the real orbit. after = with the Rewind positions added; null if nothing measured.

quiz.answer_text: Maybe. There is a faint bump in the middle, but noise could do that too.
